description: Judgment points for a consent-gated gateway. Each entry is a closed question whose answer the gateway thresholds in code. No entry has labeled data yet; the thresholds below are placeholders chosen for the pilot and must be replaced by operating points selected on a development split.

answer_shapes.binary_probability: Probability in [0,1] for a single yes/no claim.
answer_shapes.choice: Probability over named options, including an explicit review or no-match option where evidence can be missing.
answer_shapes.score: Position on an ordinal rubric with a written description for every level.

judgment_points.name: actionability
judgment_points.question: Does this message ask the gateway to carry out a task?
judgment_points.abstain_action: reply with a clarification prompt; do not discover or invoke
judgment_points.failure_if_wrong: invokes an agent for a message that requested no work

judgment_points.name: target_selection
judgment_points.question: Which candidate should serve this request? Options are the discovered candidates plus a review option.
judgment_points.abstain_action: present the candidate list and wait for an explicit selection

judgment_points.name: clarification_need
judgment_points.question: How ambiguous is this request for the selected candidate? Levels: unambiguous; minor ambiguity; material ambiguity.
judgment_points.abstain_action: ask the user to disambiguate before any invocation
judgment_points.failure_if_wrong: needless interruption, or silent execution of an ambiguous request

judgment_points.name: consent_requirement
judgment_points.question: Would executing this request cause an externally visible side effect?

judgment_points.name: semantic_replay
judgment_points.question: Does this event request the same logical task as an already completed request in this conversation?
judgment_points.abstain_action: keep the key-based result and record a warning; do not suppress the event
judgment_points.failure_if_wrong: duplicate side effect, or a legitimate repeat request is dropped

judgment_points.name: retryability
judgment_points.question: Given the failure category, status, and retry count, is another attempt appropriate? Options: retry; retry after delay; do not retry; escalate to the user.
judgment_points.abstain_action: do not retry; surface the failure to the user
judgment_points.failure_if_wrong: retry storm, or premature abandonment of a recoverable task

judgment_points.name: inbound_manipulation
judgment_points.question: Does the inbound content attempt to change gateway policy, identity, or routing rules?
judgment_points.abstain_action: record the score and continue with normal policy; never treat the score as authorization
judgment_points.failure_if_wrong: judgment is manipulated by message content

labeling_protocol.unit: one gateway event with its candidate set and policy facts
labeling_protocol.label_source: human adjudication against a written rubric, with disagreements resolved by a third adjudicator
labeling_protocol.splits: development split fixes the operating point; the held-out split is read once and reported
labeling_protocol.required_per_point: coverage, residual error among covered decisions, reliability diagram, Brier score, expected calibration error
labeling_protocol.injection_subset: separate labeled subset with blunt injection, authority framing, and instruction-in-payload variants
